ops.text: IV Licensee may terminate this Agreement for convenience, in whole or in part, at any time upon thirty (30) (30) days' prior written notice to Licensor, without penalty, early termination charge or further liability for fees accruing after the effective date of termination, in which case Licensor shall refund to Licensee any prepaid fees covering the period after the effective date of such termination. Licensor shall have no right to terminate this Agreement for convenience during the Initial Period or any extension or renewal thereof.

input.comment: [Playbook] We have added a Licensee right to terminate for convenience on 30 days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, since the Agreement commits us to a 36-month term with no exit; our playbook does not accept a multi-year term without a convenience right. If helpful, we can move to 60-90 days' notice as a fallback.
input.summary: Add Licensee termination for convenience on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund; confirm Licensor has no convenience right during the term.
